title: Using explainable machine learning and fitbit data to investigate predictors of adolescent obesity.
summary: Explainable boosting machine on ABCD Fitbit subset; cross-validation/fine-tuned AUC and interaction associations reported. An explainable boosting machine learns associations between ABCD Fitbit-derived behavior/heart-rate features and adolescent obesity; cross-validation and a fine-tuned model achieved AUC ≥0.726 and ≥0.737, respectively, and identified interactions. This is cross-sectional prediction/association, not causal or clinical evidence.
